# Favicon regression fixture

`telar.ico` is an unchanged copy of the project's root favicon supplied with
the agent-card loading report. It contains 16, 32, 48 and 64 pixel uncompressed
32-bit images. Keeping the fixture here makes the regression independent of
the working directory and of untracked files at the repository root.

SHA-256: `50c59f995a4998304200dbaebe92353e52c13cb6f5aa0ddfb7910964cdb7e8b7`.
